description: A train by number (Amtrak 5, VIA 1, IC 1, or a bare number) or a European station by name. Answers `record` (the stored run: operator, route, origin, destination, state, delay, last and next stop, every stop with scheduled and actual times; or a station with UIC code, coordinates and operators) and `live` (the same run rebuilt from the upstream now), or `matches` when several runs or stations fit. Amtrak and VIA Rail via Amtraker, Finland via Fintraffic, stations via Trainline (ODbL).

query.description: Train number, run id or station name, e.g. Amtrak 5

name: train_lookup
title: Train Lookup
